literal_source_claim_en: The equation a*x + b*y = gcd(a,b) has integer solutions.
source_attribution: Etienne Bezout, 1779 (ASCII rendering of untrusted catalog metadata only)
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For every pair of integers a and b, there exist integers x and y such that the nonnegative gcd of a and b, embedded in the integers, equals a*x + b*y.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not quantify a, b, x, or y; declare input and coefficient domains; define gcd or its sign and cast convention; order the binders; orient the equality and products; or resolve zero and negative inputs. No primary edition, theorem/page, correction audit, or independent review is recorded. Selecting one exact Lean proposition at intake would silently supply proposition-changing choices.
